title: Enjoyed for years but cap is now wearing noticeably
text: Enjoyed for years but cap is now wearing noticeably. I like this tumbler and have used it for a number of years.  I stopped using for reasons I can't remember.  After a few more years I started using it again.  It functioned without any problems all this time, but now, the rubber like material surrounding the cap has begun to wear noticeably - at the point where my thumb usually rests when twisting the cap on and off.  A nickel-sized piece has come loose. If I mash it back in, it will stick for a while until I have to mash it again.  I can't put it in the dishwasher because if I do, the piece will be forced off.  I'd request a replacement under Contigo's warranty program, but they don't cover return shipping - which would likely be a good chunk of what it cost to purchase a new one. Buying a new one is a more attractive option because shipping is free with Prime. Given this, the warranty is pretty much useless.  Some might say I shouldn't complain because I got years of use from the product.  But this ignores the material defect and the warranty shortcomings.  Anyway, that's my 2 cents.
